items.title: Squanderers Announce New Album Bright Madness: Hear “Theme For The Casino At 5 A.M.”
items.summary: Two years ago, underground OGs David Grubbs and Kramer teamed up with nouveau legend Wendy Eisenberg under the name Squanderers, playing sparse, searching improvisational guitar-bass music with no further accompaniment. The trio released their debut album, If A Body Meet A Body, on Kramer's Shimmy-Disc label in 2024, then followed it with a second LP, Skantagio, in 2025.

items.title: V.V. Lightbody Announces New Album Period Piece: Hear “Practice Smiling”
items.summary: Late last year, Chicago's V.V. Lightbody shared a very pretty song called "Best Problem" with strings from Macie Stewart. Now, the singer-songwriter is announcing her new album Period Piece to follow 2020's Make A Shrine Or Burn It, and it's her first with herself as the lead producer.
